changelog.changes:
* First release of AxTVBrowser, continued from TV Bro as its own app
* Two apps: the system WebView engine and a bundled GeckoView
* TV interface for remotes: D-pad navigation, virtual cursor, game controller sticks
* Phone interface for touch devices, with a way back to the TV interface on a TV
* Built-in video player: HLS, DASH and files, quality, audio, subtitles, speed, picture-in-picture
* Ad blocking: EasyList, EasyPrivacy and regional lists, element hiding, per-site settings
* Bookmarks in folders, HTML import and export, sync between a phone and a TV
* Resumable downloads and a download folder of your own
* History, find in page, address suggestions
* HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy
* Bing as the default search engine, home page shortcuts for Chinese sites
* About: the license and the privacy policy as browsable pages
